name: price-change-guard
description: Catches risky price changes as they happen (a big jump or drop, or a price below cost) and proposes reverting them, so a manager approves or keeps each one.

howItWorks.label: Checks
howItWorks.text: Changes above the percentage you set, and prices below cost or under your minimum margin

howItWorks.label: Proposes
howItWorks.text: Reverting the price, so a manager approves the revert or keeps the new price

howItWorks.label: Optional
howItWorks.text: Posts each risky change to a Slack channel

plugins.reason: Alerts a channel when a risky price change is waiting for review

data.description: What the product costs the store, to catch prices below cost
The original price shown crossed out during a sale, to tell a planned discount from a mistake

parameters.label: Flag changes above (%)
parameters.description: A price that rises or falls by more than this in one change is flagged

parameters.label: Minimum margin (%)
parameters.description: Flag prices that leave less than this margin over cost; 0 flags only prices below cost

parameters.label: Slack channel
parameters.description: Optional; where risky changes are posted for the manager
